currencyNote: NGN and USD are separate market prices, not exchange-rate conversions. Final scope and fees are confirmed in a written quote.

motion.title: Motion design
motion.description: 15-30 second product launches, app showcases, and animated interface films.

items.title: Startup product showcase
items.scope: One 15-30 second film in one agreed format.

items.title: Established company showcase
items.scope: A product or brand story with a more involved creative scope.

items.title: Campaign / multiple deliverables
items.scope: A coordinated set of films or campaign assets, scoped together.

motion.includes: Creative direction, animation, timing, sound design, one finished MP4 in one agreed format, and two consolidated revision rounds.
motion.excludes: Additional formats, voiceover, bespoke illustration or 3D, further revisions, rush work, and editable source files are quoted separately.

editing.title: Video editing
editing.description: Editing supplied footage for music, brands, personal projects, and social content. No posting is included.

items.title: Personal / cinematic edit
items.scope: One 15-30 second edit from up to 5 minutes of supplied footage; pacing, colour, transitions, and sound.

items.title: Song promotion edit
items.scope: One 15-45 second music-led edit using supplied, cleared audio and footage; beat-led cuts and text treatment.

items.title: Brand collaboration edit
items.scope: One 15-60 second branded video from supplied footage, with captions, logo treatment, colour, and sound.

items.title: Social / talking-head clip
items.scope: One clip up to 60 seconds from up to 10 minutes of footage, with cleanup, captions, and light B-roll.

items.title: Long-form / YouTube edit
items.scope: One finished video up to 10 minutes from up to 30 minutes of supplied footage; editing, colour, and audio cleanup.

editing.includes: One finished MP4 in one agreed aspect ratio and two consolidated revision rounds within the agreed brief. Delivery timing is agreed before work starts.
editing.excludes: Filming, advanced VFX/3D, extra versions, source files, rush work, and additional revisions are separate. You supply footage, music, brand assets, and any needed permissions.
editing.posting: Posting on Furreal accounts, paid-ad usage, licensing, exclusivity, and campaign management are quoted separately. No views, engagement, or campaign results are guaranteed.
editing.payment: Proposed editing terms: 50% upfront and 50% before final delivery. The issued project quote confirms the final terms.

items.title: Personal portfolio / CV website

items.title: Small business / brochure site

items.title: Corporate / professional services

items.title: Beauty / salon / wellness website

items.title: Restaurant / food business

items.title: Event / wedding / conference

items.title: NGO / charity / community

items.title: Religious / ministry website

items.title: School / academy website

items.title: Real estate listing website
items.scope: Editable property listings and agent enquiries.

items.title: Clinic / healthcare information

items.title: Hotel / hospitality website
items.scope: Rooms, offers and an existing booking-provider link.

items.title: Blog / publication / news CMS
items.scope: Editable articles, categories and publishing access.

items.title: Training / course campaign + CMS
items.scope: One programme, admin editing, images and registration.

items.title: Single-vendor online store
items.scope: Up to 25 initial products, orders and one payment gateway.

items.title: Digital downloads / product store
items.scope: Catalogue, one gateway and protected file delivery.

items.title: Appointment / booking system
items.scope: One business, availability and booking administration.

items.title: Restaurant ordering system
items.scope: Menu, cart, order workflow and delivery-zone settings.

items.title: Hotel reservation platform
items.scope: Room inventory, dates, booking workflow and admin.

items.title: Membership / subscription portal
items.scope: User accounts, access levels and one recurring gateway.

items.title: Online learning / LMS
items.scope: Courses, lessons, enrolment and learner accounts.

items.title: Directory / classifieds website
items.scope: Listings, search, owner submission and moderation.

items.title: Job board / recruitment portal
items.scope: Job listings, employer access and applications.

items.title: Client portal / internal dashboard
items.scope: One business workflow, role access and reporting.

items.title: SaaS / custom web app MVP
items.scope: One core workflow, authentication and admin tools.

items.title: Multi-vendor marketplace
items.scope: Seller access, listings and orders; payouts scoped first.

items.title: Logistics / delivery portal
items.scope: Shipment requests, status tracking and operations admin.

items.title: Crowdfunding / fundraising platform
items.scope: Campaigns, payment handoff and moderation workflow.

items.title: Fintech / regulated-data platform
items.scope: Paid discovery and architecture only; build quoted after.

care.title: Essential care
care.scope: Up to 2 hours a month: small edits, health checks and updates.

care.title: Business care
care.scope: Up to 4 hours a month: edits, updates, checks and backup review.

care.title: Commerce / application care
care.scope: Up to 8 hours a month: workflow checks and technical maintenance.

web.includes: Responsive design, agreed pages/workflows, basic metadata and search setup, testing, deployment assistance, Git source handover, one admin handover session, and two consolidated revision rounds. Includes 30 days of fixes for defects in the agreed functionality after launch.
web.excludes: Domain, hosting, database, email/SMS, plugins, stock licences, gateway fees and usage overages are separate provider costs. New features, redesigns, third-party outages and unlimited content changes are not included.
web.payment: One full payment when the agreed website is complete, tested and approved by the client. No deposit or development instalments. Source handover follows settlement. Quotes are valid for 14 days.
web.careTerms: Optional care starts at handover. Month one is included in the completion payment if selected; later months are billed in advance. Hours do not roll over. New features, redesigns, bulk uploads and 24/7 support are excluded. Extra work starts at NGN 15,000/hour with approval. No automatic charge is authorized.
web.additions: Extra static page from NGN 30,000; extra revision round from NGN 25,000; standard payment-gateway integration from NGN 100,000. Migration, copy, SEO campaigns, multilingual content and rush delivery are quoted separately.
